title: Can two guests both check into one room?
situation: Two guests swear they booked the same room at the same moment, and the hotel must sort it out.

goals.Captain Timeout: To sleep in Room 12, the only room with a view of the sea he can see from his bunk.
goals.Ms. Context: To stay in Room 12 under the stars, which she remembers as "the one with the pillows, or was that the bathtub?"
goals.Pierce: To make both guests happy without being blamed for anything, even things that did not happen.
goals.Vex: To get through one quiet shift without anyone asking for a cocktail named after their own mistakes.
goals.Madame Halloran: To restore order to the hotel, while secretly enjoying every bit of the chaos.
